reviews.body: Both findings addressed cleanly —  is now used via a thin local `client` fixture, the module-level `app` import and `importlib.reload` are gone, and `disable_admin_csrf` correctly threads the same app through `dependency_overrides`. Type annotations are a nice bonus. LGTM.

Type annotations are a nice bonus. LGTM.
